structural_change: Original slab parent gate6761ownflops sharedclockspine insertion1771.3/spread510.7 fails dieclock requirement. Existing parent request/tag/scale merge/argmax/output registers extracted unchanged into hardened core leaf. Four scale columns+four multiplier leaves retain ownroots; new parent onlywires andoneentry perchild. No latency change; exact original TP8 golden bench and scale-return bit-swap mutant prove extraction. Core boundary correction: register all 1,024 scale-return bits and 512 data/16 valid/32 error multiplier-return bits at their input pins; delay residual operand, tags and valid stages accordingly. +2 result edges, unchanged values/order; avoids input lane_err four-level control path and column OR before a pin capture.
